newsitem.title: DENMARK: DANISH JULY SHARE TRADING VOLUME UP 108 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: DANISH JULY SHARE TRADING VOLUME UP 108 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Danish share turnover reached a market value of 31.8 billion crowns in July 1997, a rise of 108 percent compared to July 1996 and up 12 percent on June 1997, the Copenhagen Stock Exchange said on Monday.
Average daily share trading was 1.4 billion crowns, the same as in the previous month.
Novo Nordisk was the month's most traded share with four billion crown volume, followed by Tele Danmark B shares with a turnover of 2.3 billion crowns in market value.
Danish bond turnover totalled 676.9 billion crowns in July, a 46 percent rise on July last year and 45 percent up on June 1997, it said.
On average daily bond volume amounted to 29.4 billion crowns, up from 23.3 billion crowns in the previous month.
